items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Lil was our agent you know. She was booking us around

ctx.x: Well this little venture of yours at the Warwick, I mean was that a big band you took in there?

No, it was about six pieces. You see, but we had such big names then. Oh, Father Hines and Louis Armstrong and Lil was our agent you know. She was booking us around and thats when I played over on the West Side. And some cat come in boy and some girl was right in front of the band just shaking and going on. And her old man must have walked in. And he slapped her and come up with pistol, see, and asked Louis, say, what's the matter, you don't like it? And Louis said, man, that's alright with me.
